text: The Chair and the Members of the Board of Governors of Exhibition Place acknowledge, thank and applaud Paula Oliveira, for her years of service and dedication as a Member to the Board of Governors of Exhibition Place. A crystal clock will be engraved with Paula’s name and years of service to the Board and delivered to her along with a letter conveying the Board’s appreciation. The Members of the Board, Management, and Staff applaud Paula and wish her all the best in her future endeavors.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Directed the Chair, Board of Governors of Exhibition Place to send a letter to Paula Oliveira conveying the Board’s appreciation for her service on the Board.
